_help: Messages to clients (spec 5.9 and the links we send). Nothing is sent automatically: the admin fills these in, you can edit them, and you press send in WhatsApp or your email. Placeholders: see ../../README.md. subject is used for email.

portal_link.label: Client portal link
portal_link.subject: Your project page: {{project_title}}
portal_link.text:
Hi {{contact_first_name}}, here is your project page: {{link}}
Everything in one place: where we are, what we need from you, your documents, and the files to review. Keep this link, it stays the same.

intake_link.label: Intake questionnaire link
intake_link.subject: A few questions before we start
intake_link.text: Hi {{contact_first_name}}, thanks for your time! Before we put the proposal together, could you answer a few questions? It takes about five minutes on your phone: {{link}}

proposal_link.label: Proposal
proposal_link.subject: Your proposal: {{project_title}}
proposal_link.text:
Hi {{contact_first_name}}, here is our proposal for {{project_title}}: {{link}}
Have a look and tell me if anything should change. When you are happy with it, a written OK here is all we need.

quotation_link.label: Quotation
quotation_link.subject: Quotation: {{project_title}}
quotation_link.text: Hi {{contact_first_name}}, here is the quotation for {{project_title}}: {{link}}

agreement_link.label: Agreement
agreement_link.subject: Agreement: {{project_title}}
agreement_link.text:
Hi {{contact_first_name}}, here is the agreement for {{project_title}}: {{link}}
Once it is signed and the deposit is in, we book the first shoot.

welcome_pack_link.label: Welcome pack
welcome_pack_link.subject: Welcome to Studiio
welcome_pack_link.text: Welcome to Studiio, {{contact_first_name}}! Here is exactly how the next weeks will go: {{link}}

deliverables_ready.label: Files ready to review
deliverables_ready.subject: Ready to review: {{project_title}}
deliverables_ready.text:
Hi {{contact_first_name}}, round {{round}} is ready to review on your project page: {{link}}
Please send all your feedback in one message within {{feedback_days}} working days, or approve it there if you are happy.

invoice_link.label: Invoice
invoice_link.subject: Invoice {{invoice_no}}: {{project_title}}
invoice_link.text: Hi {{contact_first_name}}, here is invoice {{invoice_no}} for {{project_title}}: {{invoice_amount}}, due {{invoice_due}}. {{link}}

payment_thanks.label: Payment received, thank you
payment_thanks.subject: Payment received
payment_thanks.text: Hi {{contact_first_name}}, we received your payment of {{last_payment}}. Thank you!

kickoff_recap.label: Kickoff recap
kickoff_recap.subject: Kickoff recap: {{project_title}}

handover.label: Handover (final files)
handover.subject: Your final files: {{project_title}}
handover.text: Hi {{contact_first_name}}, your final files are ready: {{#delivery_link}}{{delivery_link}}{{/delivery_link}}{{^delivery_link}}[add the link]{{/delivery_link}}. Inside you will find {{deliverables_summary}}. The link stays active until {{link_expiry_date}}, so please download and back everything up. It was a pleasure working on this.

testimonial.label: Feedback and testimonial (3 days after handover)
testimonial.subject: Two quick questions
testimonial.text: Hi {{contact_first_name}}, now that everything is delivered, two quick questions: what worked well, and what could we have done better? And if you are happy with the result, a few lines we can share would mean a lot.

referral.label: Referral (after a positive reply)
referral.subject: Thank you
referral.text: Thank you. If you know another business owner who needs content like this, I would be glad if you introduced us.

checkin.label: Check-in ({{checkin_days}} days after delivery)
checkin.subject: Checking in
checkin.text: Hi {{contact_first_name}}, checking in. How has the content been performing since we delivered? If you have something new coming up, I am happy to plan it with you.

renewal.label: Retainer renewal summary
renewal.subject: This month, and next
renewal.text:
Hi {{contact_first_name}}, a quick summary of this month.
Delivered: [what we delivered]
What performed best: [the best post and why]
Plan for next month: [the plan]
Shall we go ahead?
